title: FERPA student education-record privacy
why: Student education records belong to the school boundary and are protected under FERPA: access is limited to school officials with legitimate educational interest and authorised parents or eligible students, third-party disclosure requires written consent and a permanent disclosure log, and directory information requires an opt-out.

addRequirements.title: Education records are restricted to legitimate educational interest
addRequirements.statement: When an actor requests a student education record, the application shall grant access only to the student's verified parent, an eligible student, or a school official scoped to that student's school and assigned roster.
addRequirements.definition: Being authenticated inside a district is not permission to browse every student: roster and institutional role gate every read.
addRequirements.failurePath: If roster assignment or institutional role cannot be verified, the application denies the read and logs the denied attempt.
acceptance: Given a teacher assigned to classroom A, when they query a student enrolled only in classroom B, then access is denied.
Given a verified parent, when they read education records, then only their own child's records are returned.
Given two schools or districts, when an administrator queries student records, then no record from another institution is visible.

addRequirements.title: External disclosures require consent and a permanent disclosure log
addRequirements.statement: When personally identifiable information from a student education record is disclosed outside the school, the application shall verify recorded written consent or a declared FERPA exception and write an append-only disclosure record retained for the life of the education record.
addRequirements.definition: Every disclosure names the recipient, the records released, the legitimate interest or consent reference, and the timestamp.
addRequirements.failurePath: If neither valid consent nor an enumerated statutory exception is recorded, or if the disclosure log write fails, the disclosure is refused.
acceptance: Given a third-party export with no recorded parent or eligible-student consent and no statutory exception, when requested, then the export is refused.
Given a permitted disclosure, when the disclosure ledger is inspected by a parent or school official, then recipient, purpose, fields and timestamp are recorded and immutable.

addRequirements.title: Directory-information opt-outs and record-amendment requests are enforced
addRequirements.statement: When a parent or eligible student opts out of directory information or submits a record-amendment request, the application shall suppress directory fields across all non-official views and record the amendment decision or attached statement of disagreement.
addRequirements.definition: Opt-out flags travel with the student record across exports, rosters and search results, and contested records retain their formal amendment trail.
addRequirements.failurePath: If opt-out status is unknown on a student record, directory disclosure defaults to suppressed rather than public.
acceptance: Given a student with directory opt-out enabled, when a directory listing or public roster is queried, then that student's directory fields are excluded.
Given a denied amendment request, when the parent attaches a statement of disagreement, then subsequent disclosures of the contested record include that statement.

addGates.statement: Roster-scoped student-record access and append-only FERPA disclosure logging are proven by automated tests.
